invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null HoodieWriteMetadata object since it delegates to an executor's execute() method which returns a new object.
The result metadata's list of WriteStatus objects should not be null after delete.
The size of the list returned from getWriteStatuses() should never be negative.
The method only makes sense if the list of keys to delete is not null.
instantTime is an essential parameter and should not be null when used for file system operations.
